name: LayeredDepthCard
job: A card built from stacked flat layers (background, product, shadow, label) that separate in parallax as the card tilts
visitor_action: move pointer or tilt to separate layers; on touch, dragging shifts the layers; arrow keys shift them when focused
mobile: slow idle float, drag to shift layers
motion: layers translate by depth with smoothed pointer easing, balloon and hanging tag swing as pendulums, staged paper-by-paper entrance (reduced-motion: layers locked at a gentle offset)
art_direction: Paper theatre: layered matte cut-paper in dusk coral and indigo, soft stepped shadows between planes, grainy print texture
